column2: I have come to share more than a husband with [polygamy_lover.GetFirstName], another of his wives. What has grown between us in the quiet of the women's quarters is a love and tenderness I have never once felt with [Root.Spouse.GetFirstName].
I feel alive again!

The most disturbing rumour has reached me. Two of my wives, [polygamy_wife.GetFirstName] and [polygamy_lover.GetFirstName], have been sharing their beds with each other! The whole household must be laughing behind my back. Something must be done about this shameful thing.
Who am I to stand in the way of love? Just be more discreet.
This disgraceful behaviour ends now!
They will pay with their lives...

[polygamy_wife.GetFirstName] and [polygamy_lover.GetFirstName] are gone! My guards have searched every corner of the palace, and two of the swiftest camels in my stables are missing. The gate watch saw two veiled riders leave for the desert before dawn.
Send out riders! Find them!
Let them go. The desert will judge them.
Your riders search the desert for your wives.

My riders ran them down at a dry well three days into the deep desert, their camels spent and their water gone. They did not run and they did not plead. As my riders closed in, [polygamy_wife.GetFirstName] and [polygamy_lover.GetFirstName] sat down together in the sand, hand in hand, and drank from the same small vial. By the time my men reached them it was over.
NO!
I should be first among the wives of [Root.Spouse.GetFirstName]. That [polygamy_first_wife.GetFirstName] stands above me shames us both. For his sake, if not my own, I should act.
Poison [polygamy_first_wife.GetFirstName].
You slip poison into [polygamy_first_wife.GetFirstName]'s food...
Woo [Root.Spouse.GetFirstName].
You try to win your husband over.
No, I must accept my station.

[polygamy_first_wife.GetFirstName], the first of my wives, has died without warning, and my physicians swear nothing could have been done. They suspect poison. [From.GetFirstName] can barely hide her joy, and as my guards search her quarters one of them finds a half-empty vial...
What is done is done. Let us look to the future.
Is... is that poison? Guards, take her to the dungeons!
Make her drink what is left in the vial!
One of my husband's lesser wives, [From.GetFirstName], has tried to poison me in a desperate bid to become first wife! Blind luck alone let me find the poison in my dish before it was too late.
[Root.Spouse.GetFirstName] must be told of this!
Is told of the attempt on her life.

[From.GetFirstName], first among my wives, comes to me in a fury. She says she caught [polygamy_schemer.GetFirstName], one of my lesser wives, poisoning her food! What my guards have found seems to bear her out.
It pains me, but the punishment for this must be death...
Let her think on her crime in the dungeons!
I cannot fight all your battles for you, [From.GetFirstName]!
I can't fight all your battles for you, [Root.GetFirstName]! Just tell her not to do it again.
But... but she tried to KILL me!
[From.GetFirstName], one of my wives, wants to be first wife, and she has spent many nights trying to charm me into raising her above [polygamy_first_wife.GetFirstName].
Yes, she would make a good first wife...
No. [polygamy_first_wife.GetFirstName] is first among my wives, now and always.
That witch [polygamy_schemer.GetFirstName] has somehow ensnared [Root.Spouse.GetFirstName] with her sorcery! She has wheedled him into giving her my rightful place as first among his wives.
Quick! Where is the poison?
You try to poison [polygamy_schemer.GetFirstName]...
If that is his wish...

Tragic news, Master! [polygamy_schemer.GetFirstName], your new first wife, has died, and your physicians all agree that poison was the cause. [From.GetFirstName], your former first wife, mad with jealousy, has made no attempt to hide her guilt. What should be done with her?
Let her go. She must truly love me!
Send the witch to rot in the dungeons!
As my first wife died, so shall she!

I am the first wife of [Root.Spouse.GetTitledFirstName], yet the heir he has named is no child of mine. Perhaps I could persuade my husband to give my son [polygamy_son.GetFirstName] a county of his own, and with it some power and standing...
Yes, my son deserves more!
No, my husband knows best...
You tell your boy of your plans.

My dear mother, [From.GetTitledFirstName], is very upset that for all her standing as my father's first wife, his named heir is not her child. Today she told me she means to plead with my father to give me land, to raise up her favourite little boy... me.
Mother, you're embarrassing me!
Your mother corners your father.

My first wife, [From.Mother.GetFirstName], has cornered me yet again, wailing about her shame that my heir is not her child. She begs me to give her precious boy [From.GetFirstName] a county of his own.
Fine, fine. If it will get you off my back...
No. I do not care who his mother is. He has not earned it.
For all my mother's pleading, my father will not give me land yet. In fact he seems rather disappointed that I let my mother fight my battles for me...
But... but... I never asked her to...!

I have toiled long for my husband, [Root.Spouse.GetTitledFirstName], and given him a son. But his heir, [polygamy_victim.GetFirstName], is no child of mine, and once [polygamy_victim.GetSheHe] takes the throne my son may be killed as a pretender. Perhaps it would be best to strike first...
I do this for my son!
You prepare a cup of poisoned sherbet...
No, I cannot do this...

One of my wives, [From.GetFirstName], has been caught trying to give a cup of poisoned sherbet to [polygamy_victim.GetFirstName], my [polygamy_victim.GetSonDaughter] and heir. Only the child's sharp nose gave the poison away before [polygamy_victim.GetSheHe] drank, and the cup was spilled. A palace cat lapped it up and died where it stood. It seems she meant to make her own son my heir...
You would kill my own child? This will cost you dearly.
Throw her into the dungeons!
Oh well. Just don't do it again.

My [polygamy_victim.GetSonDaughter] and heir, [polygamy_victim.GetFirstName], has died after a sudden, mysterious sickness. My advisors and I suspect foul play, but we have no idea where to lay the blame...
My [polygamy_victim.GetSonDaughter]...

My [polygamy_victim.GetSonDaughter] and heir, [polygamy_victim.GetFirstName], is dead, poisoned with a cup of sherbet by [From.GetFirstName], my treacherous wife! It seems she murdered the child to see her own son named heir.
You will suffer a thousand deaths for this, woman.
Throw the wretch into the dungeons!
Oh well. What is done is done.

I have toiled long for my husband, [Root.Spouse.GetTitledFirstName], and given him a son. But he has other sons, not of my blood, who will one day want what is my son's. Young [polygamy_victim.GetFirstName] is one of them. Perhaps it would be best to strike first...

One of my wives, [From.GetFirstName], has been caught trying to give a cup of poisoned sherbet to my son [polygamy_victim.GetFirstName], born of another wife. Only the boy's sharp nose gave the poison away before he drank. It seems she wants to raise her own children's standing with me...
My son [polygamy_victim.GetFirstName] has died after a sudden, mysterious sickness. My advisors and I suspect foul play, but we have no idea where to lay the blame...
My son...
My son [polygamy_victim.GetFirstName] is dead, poisoned with a cup of sherbet by [From.GetFirstName], my treacherous wife! It seems she murdered him to raise her own children's standing with me.
